hypotheses.subject: io-shop heap (memory_used_bytes / process heap)
hypotheses.summary: io-shop is leaking memory: heap grew monotonically from ~466MB baseline starting 2026-09-19T23:47Z to 1.42GB of a 2GB limit by the alert, with no process restart (process_start_time_seconds constant at 1789841762.977432) and no deploy or config change in the preceding week. Latency degraded (p95 217ms -> 743ms) as GC pressure rose, which is what tripped the alert; error rate stayed at baseline.

supporting_evidence.claim: memory_used_bytes 471934736 at 23:46 -> 491220328 at 23:47 -> 515091126 at 23:48 -> 559055694 at 23:49, and continuing monotonically to 1415852639 at 2026-09-20T00:16:00Z against memory_limit_bytes 2147483648
process_start_time_seconds is 1789841762.977432 in every bucket from 22:46 through 00:16 - the process never restarted, so growth is cumulative within one process
WARN io-shop: heap at 1038MiB of 2048MiB limit ... 1068MiB ... 1098MiB ... 1338MiB (a steady ~30MiB/min climb)
p95_ms rises with heap: 213 at 00:04, 236 at 00:06, 405 at 00:09, 743 at 00:16, while request_volume stays flat at 1200 and error_rate stays at its 0-2.5% baseline
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-12T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-20T00:16:02Z. (nothing changed in this window)

The 'account page request failed - UpstreamTimeout: payment authorization timed out' ERROR lines occur at the same 1-2 per minute rate before the onset (22:46 onward) as during it - unrelated background noise

hypotheses.summary: An unrecorded change - a feature flag flipped or a config/traffic-shape change outside the change log - started an allocation-heavy code path at ~23:47, producing the same monotonic heap climb. The change channel returned nothing for the whole week, so if such a toggle exists it was not recorded and its name is not in the evidence.

supporting_evidence.claim: Heap departs baseline sharply and stays departed from one minute to the next (471934736 at 23:46 -> 491220328 at 23:47), which is more like a switch being thrown than a gradual leak starting
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-12T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-20T00:16:02Z. (nothing changed in this window)

hypotheses.summary: A bad deployment introduced the leak. This is weakly supported: no deploy appears anywhere in an 8-day change window and the process never restarted, which a new build would have required.

supporting_evidence.claim: process_start_time_seconds 1789841762.977432 unchanged across the entire metric span - no new process was started
